subject: Exception conditions
notes: Rule: §14.6.13.1.2 2) (cite.py --check 14.6.13.1.2 "Any directly or indirectly activated runtime element terminates the run unit" -> OK 2)). A run-unit termination inside a CALLed element unwinds as the runtime's stop signal through __RunUse's try/finally, so no -1 ('completed normally') is ever returned and no continuation after the raising statement happens. Probe n5 (out/probe/exc-normal): RAISE EC-USER-X (checked) -> USE AFTER EC declarative CALLs EXN5B which executes STOP RUN -> output 'DECL-START / B-STOPS', exit 0; neither DECL-END nor AFTER-RAISE is displayed.
